name: Tishen
source:
It all started from a rumor that the school swimming pool has a ghost in it,  Every innocent life can be the victim, especially when you go there at night. The school knows it but keep it quiet, and just simply lock the pool after day time.

But, there always have some brave people which believe or not believe it, and break into the  natatorium at night, and meet the horrible creature there and with no return back.

[From [url=https://cascha-games.itch.io/ghost-in-the-pool]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这一切都始于学校游泳池里有鬼的谣言，每一个无辜的生命都可能成为受害者，尤其是当你晚上去那里的时候。学校知道这一点，但保持安静，只是在白天后锁上游泳池。

但是，总有一些勇敢的人信不信由你，在夜间闯入游泳馆，在那里遇见了可怕的生物，并且有去无回。

[来自[url=https://cascha-games.itch.io/ghost-in-the-pool]Itch.io[/url]]
